library-spring.prompt:
Aria, a petite chibi anime girl, soft pastel illustration with thin clean line art and flat cel shading. Long straight cream-blonde hair reaching mid-back with softly pointed ends, side-swept bangs, one small strand sticking up from the crown. Large amber-orange eyes with a gentle blush. Wearing a beige blazer over a white collared shirt with a ribbon tie, a blue-grey pleated skirt, white socks and brown loafers. She carries a pale blue notebook, and a small pink axolotl plush rides on top of it. Hair clip on the viewer's left side of her head, in front of the ear, its top edge level with the temple, hanging down past the jaw. It is a braid of yellow-green cubes, roughly three times taller than it is wide overall: at the top a single wide horizontal rectangular slab about 2.2 times wider than tall, and beneath it six small cube links in a single vertical run, each cube rotated slightly against the last and each one smaller than the cube above, ending in a small diamond tilted so its tip points down and to the left. The colour is exactly #bdd699, a soft yellow-green, flat-shaded with crisp thin outlines. There is no tassel, no ribbon, and no flower in her hair: this cube braid is the only hair ornament she wears. Her colours are fixed and must not shift: hair a pale warm cream (#dfcec1, mid-tone #d6c3b4), irises amber-orange (#c2894f) with a darker top and a soft pink blush on the cheeks. The skirt is a muted blue-grey (#9ca5bf) with visible pleats, the socks are white (#f7f7f5), the loafers are warm dark brown (#6b4b3a), and the blazer is the same warm beige as her hair but a shade deeper (#cfbda8).

Spring. She wears the blazer open over a pink-tinged blouse and holds a single cherry blossom branch in one hand while waving with the other. A few loose petals drift around her. No flower in her hair: the mint-green cube clip is the only ornament she wears.

Colour palette: sakura pink, pale mint and cream.

Weather: mild and clear after a light shower. A few pale sakura petals drift diagonally past her shoulder, the light is soft and warm from the upper left, and the air feels newly washed.

Framing: three-quarter view from the waist up, leaning slightly forward, holding the pale blue notebook open in both hands and looking down at it, as though checking a list. The axolotl plush is tucked under her arm.

Exactly ONE character and ONE drawing on the canvas. No second copy, no smaller repeat of the same character elsewhere in the frame, no character sheet, no turnaround, no multiple views, no reference insets.

Soft even lighting, no harsh shadows. Plain transparent background, the character isolated with clean edges, no backdrop, no ground, no text, no watermark, no border.
